header.running_head: Spying to Discover Faults in Muslims

blocks.text: Rahmaan bin Auf (RA) replied, "This is the house of Rabee'ah bin Umayyah bin Khalaf and the people here are drinking wine. What do you think (we should do)?" Hadhrat Umar (RA) said, "We have perpetrated what Allaah has prohibited when He says:
We have spied." Hadhrat Umar (RA) then went away and turned a blind eye to them.[^1]
The Incident of Hadhrat Umar (RA) with an Individual and a Group of people

Hadhrat Sha'bi narrates that when Hadhrat Umar (RA) did not see one of his companions for some time, he told Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Auf (RA) to accompany him to the man's house to see what had happened to him. When they approached the house, they found the door open. The man was sitting there and his wife was busy pouring something in his cup and giving it to him. Hadhrat Umar (RA) said to Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Auf (RA), "This is what had been keeping him away from us. Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan (RA) asked, "How will you know what is in the cup?" Hadhrat Umar (RA) said, "I fear that this may be spying." "But it is spying," Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan (RA) confirmed. "What is the way to repent for this?" Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked. Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan (RA) replied, "Do not inform him what has been learnt about his affairs and maintain only good thoughts about him." The two men then left.[^2]

Hadhrat Taa'oos reports that Hadhrat Umar (RA) left home one night to keep guard over some travellers who had set up camp on the outskirts of Madinah. It was late at night when he passed by a house where some people were drinking wine. Hadhrat Umar (RA) called out, "Is the command of Allaah being disobeyed? Is the command of Allaah being disobeyed?" One of them responded by saying, "Allaah has prohibited you from this (spying)." Hadhrat Umar (RA) then went away and left them alone.[^3]
Hadhrat Umar (RA) Scales the Wall of a Singer's House

Hadhrat Thowr Kindi narrates that Hadhrat Umar (RA) was patrolling Madinah one night when he heard a man singing in his house. Hadhrat Umar (RA) scaled the wall of the house and confronted the man saying, "O enemy of Allaah! Do you think that Allaah will conceal your wrongs when you disobey Him?"
